description: The 20-lesson launch library (docs/LISTENING-LIBRARY-LAUNCH.md). Only the five 'pilot' lessons may be submitted until their stage budget is approved; every other stage has budget 0 and cannot spend.

spec.scenario: Two people meet for the first time and exchange names, where they are from and a simple greeting.

lessons.title: Ordering a drink at a café

spec.topic: Ordering a drink at a café
spec.scenario: A customer orders a coffee and a pastry from a friendly barista, and asks the price.
A person describes a normal day: waking up, work, meals and going to bed, with simple times.

lessons.title: Which bus goes to the station?

spec.scenario: A traveller asks a passer-by which bus goes to the station and where the stop is.
A short story about a girl who loses her umbrella on a rainy day and finds it again.

spec.topic: Ordering coffee for colleagues at the office
spec.scenario: Two colleagues decide who goes to get coffee, agree on everyone's orders and sort out who pays.
A short story about friends who secretly plan a surprise birthday party and how it goes.

spec.topic: Asking for directions to a museum
spec.scenario: A visitor asks a local for directions to the museum and gets simple left, right and straight instructions.

spec.topic: Making a doctor's appointment by phone
spec.scenario: A patient phones a clinic to make an appointment and agrees a day and time.
A passenger checks in a bag at the airport desk and asks about the gate and boarding time.

spec.topic: Meeting a new colleague at work
spec.scenario: A new colleague is introduced on a first day and the two talk about their jobs and the team.
Two friends compare destinations, travel times and budget, and agree a plan for a weekend away.

spec.topic: Moving a meeting to a new time
spec.scenario: Two colleagues from different countries negotiate a new time for a meeting because of a clash.

spec.topic: Train delays and asking for a refund
spec.scenario: A passenger asks a station clerk about a delayed train and how to claim a refund.
A short story about a hiking trip where the weather turns and the group has to change their plan.
Two colleagues discuss the good and bad sides of working from home and how they organise their day.
A person talks through how they prepare for a job interview: research, questions and nerves.
Two colleagues weigh up working remotely against going to the office, with reasons and some disagreement.
A support agent calmly handles a customer complaint and agrees a solution.

lessons.title: The history of a neighbourhood market

spec.topic: The history of a neighbourhood market
spec.scenario: A local explains how a neighbourhood market began, changed over the years and why it matters.
